availability.note: CarExpert 6 Nov 2026: 50 xDrive 'now listed at $112,500 before on-road costs'. BMW AU configurator could not be opened this run (503, then fetch refused by permission check).

listPrice.note: 'now listed at $112,500 before on-road costs, up $2600 from its $109,900 list price'; BMW spokesperson: commercial decision, no equipment change. CarsGuide 40 review pricing box also shows $112,500 as top 2026 iX3 MSRP (https://www.carsguide.com.au/ev/bmw-ix3-40-edrive-102334).

batteryKwh.note: usable: 108.7kWh net, 113.4kWh gross (CarExpert); Auto Express UK lists same 108.7 usable / 113.4 gross

rangeKm.note: WLTP combined for xDrive50 M Sport on 255/45 R20 (Australia: M Sport pack and 20-inch standard per CarExpert 10 Mar 2026). ADAC (https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/bmw/ix3/na5/343922/) same 788 km / 16.4 kWh for 50 M Sportpaket xDrive. Replaces held 793 km (zecar, overseas configurator). 805 km headline is the non-M Sport base car. No AU-certified figure found.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: WLTP combined, same variant/wheel as rangeKm; held 15.3 was the TEL (low-end) figure. battery/range = 13.8, within tolerance (WLTP consumption includes charging losses).

seats.note: five-seat mid-size SUV; no model change (price rise without equipment change)

towKg.note: 'towing is rated at 2000kg braked'; notes Australian market gets mechanical tow bar. Auto Express UK and ADAC also 2,000 kg braked (12%).

insuranceAnnual.note: raised from 2800 with the $2,600 list rise; anchored between audi-q6-e-tron-rwd ($99,900, 2800) and audi-q6-e-tron-performance ($115,500, 3150), and below bmw-ix ($142,900, 3200)

depreciationCurve.note: kept from 2026-07-31: between mainstream bmw-ix1 default and steeper bmw-ix; strong demand (CarsGuide Jan 2026 'almost sold out') and a list rise rather than cuts give no evidence to steepen; luxury-EV resale still weaker than mainstream

lowConfidence: bmw-ix3-50-xdrive.availability: BMW AU configurator not opened (503 then permission refusal); availability rests on CarExpert 6 Nov 2026
bmw-ix3-50-xdrive.rangeKm: UK/German WLTP for M Sport on 20-inch, not an AU-certified figure; AU wheel style (1048 M) not confirmed identical to UK spec
bmw-ix3-50-xdrive.consumptionKwhPer100km: same source and caveat as rangeKm
bmw-ix3-50-xdrive.depreciationCurve: judged, no local resale data yet for the new generation
